items.statement: Make sure labels of over-the-counter products carry the warnings the labeling rules require.
items.quote: Review labels of OTC products for warnings required by 21 CFR 369.

items.statement: Identify the finished product with a lot or control number that allows the complete manufacturing and control history of the batch to be determined.
items.quote: A control code must be used to identify the finished product with a lot, or control number that permits determination of the complete history of the manufacture and control of the batch.

items.statement: Where the finished package control number differs from the batch number, be able to show how it relates to the batch and use it to identify the original batch.
items.quote: If not, determine how the finished package control number relates, and how it is used to find the identity of the original batch.
items.condition: package control number differs from batch number

items.statement: Do not use gang-printed labels unless they are adequately differentiated by size, shape or color.
items.quote: Use of gang-printed labels will be prohibited unless they are adequately differentiated by size, shape or color.

items.statement: Where cut labels are used, apply one of these special controls: dedicated packaging lines; electronic or electromechanical 100 percent examination of finished product; or, for hand-applied labeling, 100 percent visual examination of finished product by one person, independently verified by a second person.
items.quote: If cut labels are used one of the following special control procedures shall be used

items.statement: Labeling reconciliation may be omitted for cut or roll labeling if a 100-percent examination is performed as the regulations permit.
items.quote: Labeling reconciliation required by 211.125 is waived for cut or roll labeling if a 100-percent examination is performed according to 211.22(g)(2).

items.statement: Include in laboratory controls adequate specifications and test procedures to assure that components, in-process materials and finished products conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality and purity.
items.quote: Laboratory controls should include adequate specifications and test procedures to assure that components, in-process and finished products conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality, and purity.

items.statement: Establish a master file of specifications for all raw materials used in drug manufacture.
items.quote: Whether the firm has established a master file of specifications for all raw materials used in drug manufacture.

items.statement: Include in the raw material specification master file the sampling procedures, sample size, number of containers to sample, how samples will be identified, tests to perform, and retest dates for components subject to deterioration.
items.quote: This master file should include sampling procedures, sample size, number of containers to be sampled, manner in which samples will be identified, tests to be performed, and retest dates for components subject to deterioration.

items.statement: Verify the validity of supplier assay reports by periodically performing complete testing in-house and routinely performing identity tests on all raw materials received.
items.quote: the manufacturer is responsible for verifying the validity of the protocols by periodically performing their own complete testing and routinely conducting identity tests on all raw materials received

items.statement: Have a laboratory procedure for releasing raw materials, finished bulk drugs or packaged drugs from quarantine.
items.quote: Laboratory procedure for releasing raw materials, finished bulk drugs or packaged drugs from quarantine.

items.statement: Assign responsibility for the decision to release materials from quarantine.
items.quote: Determine who is responsible for this decision.

items.statement: Include approved suppliers in raw material specifications.
items.quote: Raw material specifications should include approved suppliers.

items.statement: For drugs under an NDA or ANDA, list in the specifications the same approved suppliers as those approved in the application.
items.quote: For NDA or ANDA drugs, the approved suppliers listed in their specifications should be the same as those approved in the NDA or ANDA.

items.statement: Staff and equip the laboratory to perform all the raw material, in-process and finished product testing it claims to do.
items.quote: If the laboratory is staffed and equipped to do all raw material, in-process, and finished product testing that is claimed.

items.statement: Where drug preparations are tested during processing, take a representative sample from the various stages of processing.
items.quote: If so, determine what type of tests are made and whether a representative sample is obtained from various stages of processing.

items.statement: Have specifications and described laboratory testing procedures for finished products.
items.quote: Specifications and description of laboratory testing procedures for finished products.

items.statement: Have procedures for checking the identity and strength of all active ingredients, including pyrogen and sterility testing if applicable.
items.quote: Procedures for checking the identity and strength of all active ingredients including pyrogen and sterility testing, if applicable.

items.statement: Where the laboratory conducts pyrogen tests, safety tests or bioassays, feed and house laboratory animals adequately.
items.quote: If the laboratory conducts pyrogen tests, safety tests, or bioassays; determine the number of laboratory animals and if they are adequately fed and housed.

items.statement: Where laboratory animals are kept, provide for their care on weekends and holidays.
items.quote: Determine what care is provided on weekends and holidays.

items.statement: Have sterility testing procedures.
items.quote: Sterility testing procedures.

items.statement: Record sterility test entries permanently, showing all results, both positive and negative.
items.quote: Entries should be permanently recorded and show all results, both positive and negative.

items.statement: Use a sterility testing facility similar to those used for manufacturing the products.
items.quote: The facility used to conduct sterility testing should be similar to those used for manufacturing products.

items.statement: Sterility testing procedures address laboratory handling of sterile samples.
items.quote: Laboratory procedures for handling sterile sample.

items.statement: Sterility testing procedures address identifying test media with specific batches.
items.quote: Procedure for identifying test media with specific batches.

items.statement: Make sure sterility test media can support the growth of organisms.
items.quote: Test media's ability to support growth of organisms.

items.statement: Sterility testing procedures address diluting products to offset the effects of bacteriostatic agents.
items.quote: Procedure for diluting products to offset the effects of bacteriostatic agents.

items.statement: Withdraw animals involved in positive pyrogen tests from use for the required period.
items.quote: Determine if animals involved in positive pyrogen tests are withdrawn from use for the required period.

items.statement: Where tests are made by outside laboratories, take precautions to ensure the laboratories' work is bona fide.
items.quote: Determine what precautions the firm takes to insure that the laboratories' work is bona fide.

items.statement: Have methods to check the reliability, accuracy and precision of laboratory test procedures and instruments.
items.quote: Methods used to check the reliability, accuracy, and precision of laboratory test procedures and instrumentation.

items.statement: Provide for complete records of all laboratory test data, including dates, endorsement by the people performing the tests, and traceability.
items.quote: The provisions for complete records of all data concerning laboratory tests performed, including dates and endorsements of individuals performing the tests, and traceability.

items.statement: Have a reserve sample program and procedures for components and finished product.
items.quote: For components and finished product, the reserve sample program and procedures should be evaluated.

items.statement: Maintain reserve samples so that they can be retrieved.
items.quote: Challenge the system and determine if the samples are maintained and can be retrieved.

items.statement: Use reserve sample storage containers that maintain the integrity of the product.
items.quote: The storage container must maintain the integrity of the product.

items.statement: Perform stability tests on the drug product in the container and closure system in which it is marketed.
items.quote: The drug product in the container and closure system in which marketed.

items.statement: Perform stability tests on solutions prepared as directed in the labeling at the time of dispensing.
items.quote: Solutions prepared as directed in the labeling at the time of dispensing.

items.statement: Place expiration dates, based on appropriate stability studies, on labels.
items.quote: Determine if expiration dates, based on appropriate stability studies, are placed on labels.

items.statement: Where penicillin and non-penicillin products are made on the same premises, test the non-penicillin products for penicillin contamination.
items.quote: If penicillin and non-penicillin products are manufactured on the same premises, whether non-penicillin products are tested for penicillin contamination.
items.condition: penicillin and non-penicillin on same premises

items.statement: Prepare master production and control records as the CGMP requirements specify.
items.quote: These records must be prepared according to the drug CGMPR's outlined in 21 CFR 211.186.

items.statement: Keep master production and control records readily available for review, even if they are not all in one location.
items.quote: These records might not be in one location, but should be readily available for review.

items.statement: Document each significant step in the manufacture, labeling, packaging and control of specific batches in the batch production and control records.
items.quote: The batch production and control records must document each significant step in the manufacture, labeling, packaging, and control of specific batches of drugs.

items.statement: Keep the separate records that make up a complete production and control record readily available to the investigator.
items.quote: A complete production and control record may consist of several separate records which should be readily available to the investigator.

items.statement: Make batch production records specific about the equipment used (for example v-blender versus ribbon blender) and processing times (for example mixing time and speed).
items.quote: It is important that batch production records be specific in terms of equipment (v-blender vs. ribbon blender) and processing times (mixing time and speed).

items.statement: Give each piece of equipment its own unique identification number.
items.quote: The equipment should have its own unique identification number.

items.statement: Standardize, control and validate the manufacturing process.
items.quote: The manufacturing process for these products must be standardized, controlled, and validated.

items.statement: Maintain complete distribution records.
items.quote: Complete distribution records should be maintained

items.statement: Check the authenticity of orders received.
items.quote: Determine and evaluate if the firm checks on the authenticity of orders received.

items.statement: Maintain records of all written and oral complaints.
items.quote: requires that records of all written and oral complaints be maintained

items.statement: Keep complaint files readily available for review.
items.quote: The complaint files should be readily available for review.

items.statement: Handle all complaints as complaints and do not inappropriately exclude any.
items.quote: Determine if all complaints are handled as complaints and not inappropriately excluded.

items.statement: Fully investigate complaints.
items.quote: Review the complaints and determine if they were fully investigated.

items.statement: Take appropriate corrective action based on the conclusions of complaint investigations.
items.quote: Evaluate the firm's conclusions of the investigation, and determine if appropriate corrective action was taken.
